```{r select-best-lw-parameters}
library(dplyr)

# Step 1: For each species, determine which length types are available
type_coverage <- lw_raw %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    has_TL  = any(Type == "TL",  na.rm = TRUE),
    has_FL  = any(Type == "FL",  na.rm = TRUE),
    has_SL  = any(Type == "SL",  na.rm = TRUE),
    has_other = any(Type %in% c("NG", "OT", "WD"), na.rm = TRUE),
    has_NA  = any(is.na(Type)),
    n_total = n()
  )

# How many species have no TL entry at all?
no_tl <- type_coverage %>% filter(!has_TL)
cat("Species with no TL entry:", nrow(no_tl), "\n")
print(no_tl$Species)

# Step 2: Select best parameter row per species
# Priority: TL > FL > SL > NA type > other
# Within each type tier, rank by sample size (Number), take highest
lw_best <- lw_raw %>%
  mutate(
    type_priority = case_when(
      Type == "TL"              ~ 1,
      Type == "FL"              ~ 2,
      Type == "SL"              ~ 3,
      is.na(Type)               ~ 4,
      Type %in% c("NG","OT","WD") ~ 5,
      TRUE                      ~ 6
    ),
    sample_size = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Number))
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  arrange(type_priority, desc(sample_size), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Rows after selection (should equal nrow(species_list)):", nrow(lw_best), "\n")

# Step 3: Flag entries that are not TL — these need a conversion note in methods
lw_best <- lw_best %>%
  mutate(
    lw_type_flag = case_when(
      Type == "TL"  ~ "TL_direct",
      Type == "FL"  ~ "FL_needs_conversion",
      Type == "SL"  ~ "SL_needs_conversion",
      is.na(Type)   ~ "type_unknown",
      TRUE          ~ "other_review"
    )
  )

table(lw_best$lw_type_flag)
```

```{r lw-coverage-summary}
# Join best parameters back to species list (which has total_N for weighting)
lw_coverage <- species_list %>%
  left_join(lw_best %>% select(Species, a, b, Type, lw_type_flag, 
                                CoeffDetermination, Number, Locality),
            by = c("accepted_name" = "Species"))

# How many species got no match at all?
no_match <- lw_coverage %>% filter(is.na(a))
cat("Species with no LW parameters at all:", nrow(no_match), "\n")
print(no_match$accepted_name)

# N-weighted coverage by flag type
lw_coverage <- lw_coverage %>%
  mutate(lw_type_flag = ifelse(is.na(lw_type_flag), "MISSING", lw_type_flag))

total_N <- sum(lw_coverage$total_N)

lw_coverage %>%
  group_by(lw_type_flag) %>%
  summarise(
    n_species = n(),
    total_N   = sum(total_N),
    pct_N     = round(100 * sum(total_N) / !!total_N, 3)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_N))

# Save
saveRDS(lw_coverage, 
  "/Users/stuartstokeld/north_sea_eeos/outputs/lw_coverage.rds")
write.csv(lw_coverage,
  "/Users/stuartstokeld/north_sea_eeos/outputs/lw_coverage.csv",
  row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r taxonomic-fallback}
library(dplyr)

# Load taxonomy to get genus and family for unmatched species
taxa <- load_taxa() %>% as.data.frame()

# Identify unmatched species
unmatched <- lw_coverage %>% filter(is.na(a))
cat("Unmatched species needing fallback:", nrow(unmatched), "\n")

# Get genus and family for unmatched species
# Parse genus as first word of accepted_name
unmatched <- unmatched %>%
  mutate(genus = stringr::word(accepted_name, 1))

# Compute genus-level mean a and b from lw_best (TL entries only where possible)
genus_means <- lw_raw %>%
  filter(Type == "TL" | is.na(Type)) %>%
  mutate(genus = stringr::word(Species, 1)) %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  summarise(
    a_genus = mean(a, na.rm = TRUE),
    b_genus = mean(b, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_genus = sum(!is.na(a))
  ) %>%
  filter(n_genus > 0)

# Compute family-level mean a and b
# Join lw_raw to taxa to get family
lw_with_family <- lw_raw %>%
  filter(Type == "TL" | is.na(Type)) %>%
  left_join(taxa %>% select(Species, Family) %>% distinct(),
            by = "Species") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Family))

family_means <- lw_with_family %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  summarise(
    a_family = mean(a, na.rm = TRUE),
    b_family = mean(b, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_family = sum(!is.na(a))
  ) %>%
  filter(n_family > 0)

# Get family for unmatched species via taxa table
unmatched_with_family <- unmatched %>%
  left_join(taxa %>% select(Species, Family) %>% distinct(),
            by = c("accepted_name" = "Species"))

# Apply fallback hierarchy: genus mean → family mean → MISSING
unmatched_filled <- unmatched_with_family %>%
  left_join(genus_means, by = "genus") %>%
  left_join(family_means, by = "Family") %>%
  mutate(
    a_final = case_when(
      !is.na(a_genus) ~ a_genus,
      !is.na(a_family) ~ a_family,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    b_final = case_when(
      !is.na(b_genus) ~ b_genus,
      !is.na(b_family) ~ b_family,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    fallback_level = case_when(
      !is.na(a_genus)  ~ "genus_mean",
      !is.na(a_family) ~ "family_mean",
      TRUE             ~ "MISSING"
    )
  )

table(unmatched_filled$fallback_level)
```

```{r check}
missing_spp <- unmatched_filled %>% filter(fallback_level == "MISSING")
missing_spp %>% 
  select(accepted_name, total_N) %>% 
  arrange(desc(total_N)) %>%
  mutate(pct_N = round(100 * total_N / sum(species_list$total_N), 4))
```
```{r assemble-final-lookup}
# Matched species: use direct parameters
matched <- lw_coverage %>%
  filter(!is.na(a)) %>%
  mutate(
    a_final       = a,
    b_final       = b,
    fallback_level = lw_type_flag
  ) %>%
  select(accepted_name, aphia_id, total_N, a_final, b_final, 
         Type, fallback_level)

# Fallback species: use genus/family means where available
fallback <- unmatched_filled %>%
  select(accepted_name, aphia_id, total_N, a_final, b_final,
         fallback_level) %>%
  mutate(Type = NA_character_)

# Bind together
lw_final <- bind_rows(matched, fallback) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_N))

# Confirm row count and coverage
cat("Total species in final lookup:", nrow(lw_final), "\n")

# N-weighted coverage summary
lw_final %>%
  mutate(coverage_class = case_when(
    fallback_level == "TL_direct"          ~ "TL_direct",
    fallback_level == "type_unknown"        ~ "type_unknown",
    fallback_level == "FL_needs_conversion" ~ "FL_needs_conversion",
    fallback_level == "other_review"        ~ "other_review",
    fallback_level == "genus_mean"          ~ "genus_mean_fallback",
    fallback_level == "family_mean"         ~ "family_mean_fallback",
    fallback_level == "MISSING"             ~ "MISSING",
    TRUE                                    ~ "other"
  )) %>%
  group_by(coverage_class) %>%
  summarise(
    n_species = n(),
    pct_N     = round(100 * sum(total_N) / sum(lw_final$total_N), 3)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_N))

# Save
write.csv(lw_final,
  "/Users/stuartstokeld/north_sea_eeos/outputs/fishbase_lw_lookup_v2.csv",
  row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(lw_final,
  "/Users/stuartstokeld/north_sea_eeos/outputs/fishbase_lw_lookup_v2.rds")

cat("Saved to outputs/fishbase_lw_lookup_v2\n")
```

```{r compute-haul-mean-lengths}
library(dplyr)

# Build haul identifier — composite key matching FishGlob haul_id structure
# Fields: Survey, Quarter, Country, Platform, HaulNumber, Year
hl_clean <- hl %>%
  filter(
    Year >= 1985, Year <= 2015,
    LengthCode != "-9",
    length_mm > 0,
    NumberAtLength > 0,
    !is.na(AphiaID)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    haul_key = paste(Survey, Year, Quarter, Country, Platform, 
                     HaulNumber, sep = "_")
  )

# Compute weighted mean length (mm) per species per haul
# Weight = NumberAtLength (already raised count with SubsamplingFactor applied)
haul_mean_length <- hl_clean %>%
  group_by(haul_key, Survey, Year, Quarter, Country, Platform, 
           HaulNumber, AphiaID, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_length_mm = weighted.mean(length_mm, w = NumberAtLength),
    total_n_measured = sum(NumberAtLength),
    n_length_bins = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Species-haul combinations:", nrow(haul_mean_length), "\n")
cat("Unique hauls:", n_distinct(haul_mean_length$haul_key), "\n")
cat("Unique species (AphiaID):", n_distinct(haul_mean_length$AphiaID), "\n")
cat("Years:", min(haul_mean_length$Year), "-", max(haul_mean_length$Year), "\n")

# Inspect a few rows
head(haul_mean_length)

# Save
saveRDS(haul_mean_length,
  "/Users/stuartstokeld/north_sea_eeos/outputs/datras_haul_mean_length.rds")
cat("Saved datras_haul_mean_length.rds\n")
```

```{r exclude-non-fish}
# AphiaIDs for non-demersal-fish taxa to exclude from community
# Cephalopods, crustaceans, bivalves, other invertebrates
non_fish_aphia <- c(
  # Cephalopods
  153131, 138138, 140270, 138139, 140271, 11734, 11760,
  141452, 140625, 11716, 140621, 141454, 11718, 141449,
  140624, 140600, 138481, 138482, 138483, 141448, 141450,
  141443, 141444, 138477, 11725, 494117, 138802, 153083,
  11707, 11709, 138802, 1437787, 1437789, 140605,
  # Crustaceans
  107254, 107276, 107205, 107253, 107347, 107350, 107398, 106789,
  # Bivalves and other invertebrates
  140712, 140687, 658802, 167039, 167569
)

# Filter haul_mean_length to fish only before LW join
haul_mean_length_fish <- haul_mean_length %>%
  filter(!AphiaID %in% non_fish_aphia)

cat("Species-haul rows before exclusion:", nrow(haul_mean_length), "\n")
cat("Species-haul rows after exclusion:", nrow(haul_mean_length_fish), "\n")
cat("Rows removed:", nrow(haul_mean_length) - nrow(haul_mean_length_fish), "\n")
```

```{r compute-haul-E}
library(dplyr)

# Load LW lookup
lw_lookup <- read.csv(
  "/Users/stuartstokeld/north_sea_eeos/outputs/fishbase_lw_lookup_v2.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Join mean lengths to LW parameters via AphiaID
# lw_lookup has aphia_id; haul_mean_length has AphiaID
haul_mass <- haul_mean_length_fish %>%
  left_join(
    lw_lookup %>% select(aphia_id, a_final, b_final, fallback_level),
    by = c("AphiaID" = "aphia_id")
  )

# Check join coverage
cat("Rows with LW parameters:", sum(!is.na(haul_mass$a_final)), "\n")
cat("Rows missing LW parameters:", sum(is.na(haul_mass$a_final)), "\n")

# What species are missing LW parameters?
missing_lw <- haul_mass %>%
  filter(is.na(a_final)) %>%
  group_by(AphiaID, Species) %>%
  summarise(n_hauls = n(), total_n = sum(total_n_measured), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_n))
print(missing_lw)

# Compute mean individual mass (grams) using W = a * L^b
# length_mm converted to cm for FishBase parameters (a, b expect cm input)
haul_mass <- haul_mass %>%
  filter(!is.na(a_final)) %>%
  mutate(
    length_cm = mean_length_mm / 10,
    mass_g    = a_final * (length_cm ^ b_final)
  )

# Compute haul-level E = sum over species of (total_n_measured * mass_g^0.75)
haul_E <- haul_mass %>%
  group_by(haul_key, Survey, Year, Quarter, Country, Platform, HaulNumber) %>%
  summarise(
    E = sum(total_n_measured * mass_g ^ 0.75),
    n_species_with_lw = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Hauls with E computed:", nrow(haul_E), "\n")
summary(haul_E$E)

saveRDS(haul_E,
  "/Users/stuartstokeld/north_sea_eeos/outputs/datras_haul_E.rds")
cat("Saved datras_haul_E.rds\n")
```
